SELECT PA_MONTH PA_MONTH, PA_HISTORY.EMPID, LOCAL_NAME CHINESENAME, PA_HISTORY.DEPT_NAME DEPARTMENT, PA_HISTORY.EMP_TYPE_NAME, PA_HISTORY.EMP_TYPE_CODE, PA_HISTORY.BASIS_SALARY, PA_HISTORY.DUTY_SALARY, PA_HISTORY.POSITION_ALLOWANCE_CAL, PA_HISTORY.NIGHT_SHIFT_FEE, NVL(PA_HISTORY.JIAOTONGFEI, 0) + NVL(PA_HISTORY.TONGXUNBUTIE, 0) JIAOTONGTONGXUN, NVL(PA_HISTORY.MEALS_ALLOWANCE, 0) + NVL(PA_HISTORY.AGENT_FEE, 0) QITAJINTIE, PA_HISTORY.MONTH_BONUS, PA_HISTORY.BONUS_TOTAL, PA_HISTORY.OT_TOTAL, NVL(PA_HISTORY.SICK_CHARGE_BACK, 0) + NVL(PA_HISTORY.LEAVE_CHARGE_BACK, 0) BINGSHIJIAKOUKUAN, NVL(PA_HISTORY.TARDINESS_DEDUCTIONS, 0) + NVL(PA_HISTORY.EARLYDAY_DEDUCTIONS, 0) + NVL(PA_HISTORY.TARD_EARLY_LONG_DEDUCTIONS, 0) + NVL(PA_HISTORY.ABSENTEEISM_DEDUCTIONS, 0) + NVL(PA_HISTORY.TARD_EARLY_TO_ABSENT, 0) CHIZAOKUANGKOUHEJI, PA_HISTORY.OTHER_DEDUCTIONS, PA_HISTORY.PAY_TOTAL, PA_HISTORY.ENDOWMENT_PERSONAL, PA_HISTORY.UNEMPLOYMENT_PERSONAL, PA_HISTORY.MEDICAL_PERSONAL, PA_HISTORY.GERENDABINGYILIAO, PA_HISTORY.HOUSE_FUNDING_PERSONAL, PA_HISTORY.BEFORE_TAXABLE_PAY_DEDUCT, PA_HISTORY.BEFORE_TAXABLE_PAY_PLUS, PA_HISTORY.SHOULD_RELEASE_SALARY, NVL(PA_HISTORY.HOT_FEE, 2) + NVL(PA_HISTORY.HEATING_FEE, 0) MEISHUFEI, NVL(PA_HISTORY.IS_TO_MEDICAL_FEE, 2) + NVL(PA_HISTORY.IS_TO_BIRTH_FEE, 0) FANYAOFEI, NVL(PA_HISTORY.FANJIN, 0) FANJIN, PA_HISTORY.AFTER_TAXABLE_PAY_DEDUCT, PA_HISTORY.TAX_PERSONAL_INCOME, PA_HISTORY.ACTUAL_RELEASE_SALARY
FROM PA_SUMMARY_C11 PA_HISTORY, HR_PERSONAL_INFO T WHERE PA_HISTORY.PERSON_ID = T.PERSON_ID
PA_HISTORY.emp_type_code = #emp_type_code:VARCHAR#
PA_HISTORY.DEPTNO IN (SELECT HD.DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HD WHERE HD.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# START WITH HD.DEPTNO = #deptid:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR HD.DEPTNO = HD.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
(PA_HISTORY.EMPID LIKE '%' || #EMPID:VARCHAR# || '%' OR PA_HISTORY.PERSON_ID LIKE '%' || #EMPID:VARCHAR# || '%' OR PA_HISTORY.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #EMPID:VARCHAR# || '%')
and PA_HISTORY.PA_MONTH = #pamonth#

SELECT A.EMPID, HDN.CONTENT DEPT_NAME, A.LOCAL_NAME, A.ANNUAL_VACATION, A.MARRIAGE_LEAVE + A.BEREFT_LEAVE HUNSANG, A.INDUSTRY_INJURY, A.BIRTHDAY_TAL, A.LIUCHANJIATIANSHU, A.WAICHUSHISHU, A.NIGHT_SHIFT, A.TARDINESS_COUNT + A.EARLYDAY_COUNT CHIDAOZAOTUI, A.ZHENGSHIBJSHISHU, A.SHIYONGBJSHISHU, A.ZHENGSHISJSHISHU, A.SHIYONGSJSHISHU, A.TIAOXIUTIANSHU, (A.ACTUAL_WORK_DAYS - A.ACTUAL_WORK_DAYS - A.INDUSTRY_INJURY - A.MATERNITY_LEAVE - A.MARRIAGE_LEAVE - A.BEREFT_LEAVE - A.SPECIAL_MATERNITY_LEAVE_DAYS - A.ANNUAL_VACATION - A.BURUJIATIANSHU - A.CHANQIANJIATIANSHU - A.CHANHOUJIATIANSHU - A.LIUCHANJIATIANSHU - A.PERIOD_DAYS - A.TANQINJIATIANSHU - A.BIRTHDAY_TAL - A.TIAOXIUTIANSHU) WEIQIN FROM AR_SUMMARY_C11 A, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDN WHERE A.AR_MONTH = #AR_MONTH:VARCHAR# AND A.DEPTNO = HDN.DEPTNO AND HDN.LANGUAGE = #LANGUAGE:VARCHAR#
A.DEPTNO IN (SELECT HD.DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HD WHERE HD.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# START WITH HD.DEPTNO = #DEPTID:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR HD.DEPTNO = HD.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
